Welcome to Rayl
Fast Lightning payments, ready when you are. No setup needed.
Get started
Blink
Connect your Blink account with an API key.
Nostr Wallet Connect
Connect a compatible wallet using its NWC connection link.

Import your Spark wallet with its recovery phrase.

Quiet scanner, quick results
It’s working — even if you can’t see the camera.
Rayl scans in the background so checkout stays smooth. Aim at the code, wait a beat, and you’re good.
Auto Pay, your rules
Pay small amounts instantly — no extra taps.
Set a limit you’re comfortable with. For anything above it, Rayl will ask before paying.
A balance for spending
Like a prepaid card for Lightning.
Top up Rayl from the wallet you save in, and keep only what you plan to spend. Your savings stay where they are.
Choose when Rayl should ask for confirmation before paying.
